title: POV: You Used The Vet Voice So Now I Don't Exist
description:
I heard the tone. I am now a rock. Rocks cannot go to the vet.

🧠 Understand the real behavior behind it: https://funnycutedogs.com/go/dogtraining

Some links in this description are affiliate links — we may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you.

#dogsoftiktok #dogpov #funnydogs
script: You said my name in that voice. The soft one. The one that means something is about to happen that I will not enjoy. I know this voice. I have catalogued this voice extensively. The second I heard it, I became invisible, I am currently under the bed, I do not respond to my name anymore, that dog does not live here. You can bring the leash. You can bring the treats. I have made my decision and my decision is that none of this is happening to me today. This isn't just stubbornness, dogs are genuinely excellent at picking up on tone and routine cues, and understanding that can actually make vet trips a lot less stressful for both of you. The link's below.
hookText: I heard the vet voice. I don't exist now.
